02 · Strategic Positioning

Not just rankings — a structured growth workflow.

The portfolio now makes the working method explicit: diagnose the opportunity, connect it to search intent, execute the right intervention, measure the signal and optimise from evidence.

01 / DISCOVER

Find the opportunity

Keyword research, competitor gaps, search intent, local demand and technical diagnostics establish where growth can be created.

02 / BUILD

Turn insight into execution

On-page optimisation, content, internal linking, technical SEO, GBP work, authority building and campaign execution are connected to the objective.

03 / PROVE

Measure what moved

GSC, analytics, ranking evidence and platform reporting are used to separate activity from actual performance evidence.

03 · Executive Profile

Performance marketing with an operator’s mindset.

My role sits at the intersection of search strategy, content execution, local visibility, measurement and growth. The objective is not to produce activity reports — it is to create a repeatable system for finding demand, capturing it and learning from the data.

STRATEGY

Start with the commercial question

What demand exists? Which queries matter? Where is the friction? Which pages, audiences or campaigns deserve priority?

EXECUTION

Build the right intervention

Translate the diagnosis into keyword architecture, technical improvements, content, local optimisation, campaign structure and conversion-focused actions.

OPTIMISATION

Use evidence to decide what happens next

Separate signal from noise, document movement, identify bottlenecks and iterate instead of treating a single reporting period as the finish line.

04 · Growth Operating System

One workflow. Multiple channels. One measurement language.

SEO, paid media, social, content, local search and analytics are strongest when they share the same business objective and measurement logic.

01Business GoalRevenue, leads, demand or visibility.→
02AudienceIntent, geography and decision stage.→
03ChannelOrganic, paid, local, social or content.→
04MeasurementRankings, clicks, engagement and actions.→
05DiagnosisFind the constraint or opportunity.→
06IterationImprove, retest and scale what works.
Operating principle: a metric is useful only when it changes a decision. Every reporting layer should answer what happened, why it happened, what should change and how the next test will be evaluated.

AEO + GEO

Modern Search & Discovery

A modern search capability within the broader performance marketing workflow, covering answer-focused and AI-powered discovery alongside traditional search.

AEO — Answer Engine Optimisation

Optimising content for direct answers and answer-focused search experiences.
  • Search-intent alignmentStructure content around the exact questions, needs and decision stages behind target queries.
  • Question-led contentBuild clear FAQ, Q&A and informational sections that make important answers easy to identify.
  • Entity clarityStrengthen relationships between brands, services, locations, people and topics through consistent content.
  • Structured informationUse clear headings, concise definitions, lists, tables and relevant structured data where appropriate.
  • Featured-answer readinessCreate concise, authoritative answer sections designed for prominent search-result visibility.

GEO — Generative Engine Optimisation

Preparing authoritative, well-structured content for AI-powered discovery and generative search.
  • Topical authorityDevelop comprehensive topic coverage and connected content that demonstrates subject depth.
  • Entity & brand signalsMaintain consistent brand, service and business information across relevant digital properties.
  • Citation-worthy contentPrioritise original, useful and clearly sourced information that can support AI-generated answers.
  • Content structureUse logical page architecture, descriptive headings and concise supporting information for machine comprehension.
  • Multi-surface visibilityConsider traditional search, local search, AI-assisted search and other discovery surfaces together.
01IntentUnderstand the query
02EntitiesMap topics & relationships
03StructureBuild answer-ready content
04AuthorityStrengthen trust signals
05MeasureTrack visibility & outcomes

Methodology

My SEO Execution Framework

A repeatable workflow designed to connect search demand, technical health, content relevance and ranking performance.

01 — Discover

Business model, audience, services/products, market and competitor landscape.

02 — Research

Keyword research, SERP analysis, search intent and keyword-to-page mapping.

03 — Audit

Technical, on-page, content, internal-linking and local SEO diagnostics.

04 — Prioritise

Separate high-impact fixes from medium- and low-priority improvements.

05 — Optimise

Implement metadata, headings, content, internal links, schema and technical fixes.

06 — Build

Develop content clusters, service content, local assets and relevant authority signals.

07 — Measure

Track rankings, GSC, organic traffic and other available performance indicators.

08 — Iterate

Use performance data to identify winners, losses, gaps and the next optimisation cycle.
